answer: Time-lock the work history: each accepted task counts only after 14 days, and only one task per identity per epoch enters the count. Auditors come from a rotating pool, so a farm cannot pre-select friendly graders. Example: 60 keys working the same garden of tasks count as 60 tasks total, not 600. The tide of new identities then moves at the speed of real work, and a beacon of high score costs two weeks plus one real task per key.
